widgets_values: - All tools used to speed up generations. All present configurations were used after alot of testing. Feel free to change/disable and test new configurations.

Choose the type of Checkpoint used. Disable the one your are not going to use.

Wan 2.2 uses a different diffusion model for the first steps (high noise) vs the last steps (low noise).

This Workflow is set to gguf by default.

Remember to attach the nodes after!

-Set you seed, Steps and CFG

-Seed: If your are not having luck with your results, try changing the seed.

-Steps: More steps means better quality but longer generation time. Its set as "6" by defult. Fell free to change it and test new configurations. Use even numbers! 

-CFG: More CFG means better results but lognger generation time. Its set as "1.3" by default. Fell free to change it and test new configurations. Use values between "1" and "1.5".

Preview of your final result video will be shown here.
If you don't where the results are going just cancel the run!
If you want to save the output change "save output" to true.

The Florence Model will Automaticly generate a prompt.
 
Feel free to disable all of nodes in here if you think Florence its not helping.

Set The lenght of your video!

3sec - 49
4sec - 65
5sec - 81
6sec - 97
7sec - 113

The last frame of you final result video will be shown here.
The image will be saved on the same folder as your video.

Set your video Size and Upscale!
By default its set to 480x720 with Upscale by 2. That results in a 960x1440 video! Default upscale method is "lanczos"!

Feel free to change anything it to fit your own specs.
Still using the same as the wan 2.1

nodes.title: Final prompt preview
widgets_values: The video is a close-up digital video of a young woman's face, featuring striking blue and orange colors with a futuristic, sci-fi aesthetic. The woman has long, straight, dark blue hair that falls down her shoulders. Her large, expressive blue eyes are the focal point of the video, with a bright, glowing iris in the center. The iris is surrounded by a nebula-like pattern of orange and blue hues, giving the video a cosmic feel. The patterns on the face move along the skin and the iris slowly spins and changes to multiple colors.
